content.title: Watch NBA live on Hulu
content.text: Oct 01, 2025 With a Hulu + Live TV subscription, you can watch and record live NBA basketball games on Hulu all season long. Log in to Hulu on any device that supports Live TV, and you'll have instant access to the live games airing through the local and regional sports networks available in your area — as well as through national networks like ABC, ESPN, ESPN2, and TNT. Select one of the options below to learn more about watching NBA on Hulu: What do I need to watch NBA on Hulu?What NBA games are available on Hulu? How do I find NBA games on Hulu? What you’ll need to watch NBA on Hulu To get in on the NBA action, you’ll need the following: Live TV subscriptionSupported deviceHome networkLive TV network coverage * *Enter your ZIP Code to confirm the network coverage in your region. BACK TO TOP Determining NBA game availability Game day availability can vary and is subject to regional restrictions and blackouts — out-of-market games may be unavailable. These restrictions are determined by sports leagues and other rights holders. With Hulu + Live TV, you can confirm if an upcoming game is unavailable or blacked out by using the Live Guide. BACK TO TOP How to find NBA games on Hulu Hulu + Live TV subscribers can go to the NBA Games Sports collection to view live games and see what match-ups are airing next (you can also search the Hulu app for the "NBA Basketball" series page). To keep track of your favorite teams and game start times, add them to My Stuff and enable push notifications on your mobile devices. BACK TO TOP
